design_notes: Lines 230-231: normally the most direct route, unless an alternative route brings significant financial gains. The Frankfurt connection saves CHF 23 of CHF 412 (under 6%), with five hours on the ground: not significant. The nonstop the traveller asked for. The five-hour stopover would earn a lounge (line 413), which chooses nothing.
